description: Yearly pay percentiles (p25, p50, p75) from the open roles on engg.space that state a pay range, for a title and optionally a place. Reports the sample size and withholds the numbers when fewer than 5 roles qualify. Pay is what employers posted: not offers, equity or bonus. `country` is an ISO-2 code like US or IN.

currency.description: ISO-4217. Default: the most common among matches

name: salary_insights
title: Posted pay for a kind of role
